arguments.description: Remove probe files and inspect ledger tail
arguments.command:
Remove-Item -Force "D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\_S1839Probe.lean","D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\_S1839Probe2.lean","D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\_S1839Check.lean" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "--- probes removed ---"
Get-Item "D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1839SliceFillingActual.lean" | Select-Object Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List
Get-FileHash "D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1839SliceFillingActual.lean" -Algorithm SHA256 | Format-List
Write-Output "--- ledger tail ---"
Get-Content "D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md" -Tail 60
